grammar_focus: 与事实相反的虚拟条件(If the water was moving …, everything would be racing …)、cause sb/sth to do(使…做)、现在分词作状语(awakening it to flow / leaving the water where it was)、it takes sth/sb + time + to do(某物做某事需要…时间)、现在完成被动(Once the waves have been generated)(NCE4 该课源无独立 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;IP:源为 BBC World Magazine 一篇讲海浪成因与运动的科普文,系版权作品——已用 100% 原创行文复述其事实、无引用原句;题材=海洋物理·无害;美语化 meter/center;第四册第40课,PDF 内误标为 Lesson 39)
scene: 海浪是海洋与大气之间那场漫长搏斗的孩子。太阳的光线为空气注入能量,唤醒它流动、运动;风随后把太阳的讯息带给大海,大海又通过波浪把它传递下去。这些海浪是一切自然现象中最复杂的之一。每一道浪都有一个波峰——浪的最高点,和一个波谷——最低点;它的浪高是从波谷到波峰的垂直距离,浪长是两个相邻波峰之间的水平距离,而周期则是一个波峰走过一个波长所需的时间。虽然一道海浪给你的印象,是一堵水墙正朝你的方向涌来,实际上浪是穿过水而行的,把水大致留在它原来的地方。假如水真的随浪一起移动,大海连同上面的一切都会冲向海岸,后果显然是灾难性的。一道穿过深水的海浪,使水面上的一个微粒沿着大致圆形的轨道运动:先把它拉向前进中的浪,再送它上到浪里,随浪向前,然后——当浪把这个微粒抛在身后——又回到它出发的那一点。从诞生到消亡,一道浪都受制于和任何别的活物一样的规律。有一阵子它显出一种奇异的个性,而后,到最后,它又被重新吸纳进它来自的那片浩瀚海洋。外海那些起伏的波浪由三种自然的力量生成:风,大地的运动或震颤,以及月亮和太阳的引力。而一旦波浪已经生成,重力便成了驱使它们前行的力量,不停地试图把海面重新恢复为平坦、齐整的一片。

grammar_card.title: 虚拟条件 would / cause sb to do / 现在分词作状语 / it takes sth time to do / 现在完成被动
grammar_card.intro: ①与事实相反的虚拟条件:If + 过去式,主句 would + 动词原形。②cause sb/sth to do,‘使某人/某物做…’,to 不能省。③现在分词作状语,表伴随:awakening it to flow。④it takes sth/sb + time + to do,‘某物做某事需要…时间’。⑤现在完成被动:have/has been + 过去分词。

rows: If + 过去式, would + 原形
If the water was moving…, it would race…
it takes sth time to do
It takes + 时间 + to do
the time it takes a crest to travel

specialRules.rule: 虚拟条件里,if 从句用过去式(be 常用 were),主句用 would/could/might + 原形。
cause、get、want、ask 等后接‘宾语 + to do’;to 不能省(区别于 make/let 后省 to)。
美式拼写:meter(米,英式 metre)、center(中心,英式 centre)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What false impression does an ocean wave convey to the observer?
options: That a wall of water is moving toward the shore, though the water itself stays about where it was
That the sea is completely still
That the water races along with the wave
That waves never move at all

passage: Waves are the children of the long struggle between the ocean and the atmosphere. Rays from the sun energize the air, awakening it to flow and to move; the wind then carries the message of the sun to the sea, and the sea transmits it onward through waves. These ocean waves are among the most complicated of all natural phenomena. Each one has a crest, the highest point of the wave, and a trough, the lowest; its height is the vertical distance from the trough to the crest, its wave length the horizontal distance between two crests, and its period the time it takes a single crest to travel one wave length. Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality the wave moves through the water and leaves the water about where it was. If the water was truly moving with the wave, the ocean and everything on it would be racing into the shore, with plainly catastrophic results. A wave passing through deep water causes a particle on the surface to move in a roughly circular orbit, drawing it toward the advancing wave, up into the wave, forward with it, and then — as the wave leaves the particle behind — back to its starting point again. From birth to death, a wave is subject to the same laws as any other living thing. For a time it takes on a kind of individuality, and then, in the end, it is reabsorbed into the great ocean from which it came. The undulating waves of the open sea are generated by three natural causes: the wind, movements or tremors of the earth, and the gravitational pull of the moon and the sun. Once the waves have been generated, gravity is the force that drives them on, in a continual attempt to restore the surface of the sea to a flat and level plain.

grammar_points.name: 与事实相反的虚拟条件(would)
it takes sth/sb + time + to do

stage5.stem: "If the water was moving with the wave, everything on it ___ racing into the shore."(与事实相反的虚拟条件,主句用‘助动词+动词’,填该助动词那一形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果水真随波移动,水上一切都会冲向海岸。

stage5.stem: "If a wave carried the water along, the results ___ be catastrophic."(虚拟条件主句,填助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果波浪把水一起带走,后果将是灾难性的。

stage5.stem: "If the sea ___ still, there would be no waves at all."(与现在事实相反,if 从句里 be 动词用哪个形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果大海静止不动,就根本不会有波浪。

stage5.stem: "An ocean wave causes a particle on the surface ___ move in a circular orbit."(cause + 宾语 + 不定式,填不定式前的那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 海浪使水面上的微粒沿圆形轨道运动。

stage5.stem: "The wind causes the sea ___ rise and fall in a steady rhythm."(cause + 宾语 + 不定式,填不定式前的那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 风使海面以平稳的节奏起伏。

stage5.stem: "Sunlight causes the atmosphere ___ flow and move."(cause + 宾语 + 不定式,填不定式前的那个词)
"Rays from the sun energize the air, ___ it to flow."(现在分词作状语,填‘唤醒’那个动词的-ing形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 阳光使空气充满能量,唤醒它流动起来。

stage5.stem: "Waves move through the water, ___ it about where it was."(现在分词作状语,填‘留下’那个动词的-ing形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 波浪穿水而过,把水留在大致原处。

stage5.stem: "The particle rises and falls, ___ back to its starting point."(现在分词作状语,填‘回来’那个动词的-ing形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 微粒起起落落,又回到它的起点。

stage5.stem: "A period is the time it ___ a wave crest to travel one wave length."(‘做…需要…时间’,填表示‘花费(时间)’那个动词的第三人称单数)
stage5.stem_cn: 周期就是一个波峰走过一个波长所需的时间。

stage5.stem: "It ___ the wave several seconds to reach the shore."(‘某物做某事需要…时间’,填那个动词的第三人称单数)
stage5.stem_cn: 波浪要好几秒才能到达岸边。

stage5.stem: "It took the storm only minutes ___ raise the waves."(它花了…时间去做某事,填不定式记号)
stage5.stem_cn: 那场风暴只用几分钟就掀起了巨浪。

stage5.stem: "Once waves ___ been generated, gravity drives them toward the shore."(现在完成被动语态,填最前面那个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 波浪一旦形成,重力便驱使它们涌向海岸。

stage5.stem: "The message of the sun ___ been transmitted to the sea by the wind."(现在完成被动语态,填那个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 太阳的讯息已由风传给了大海。

stage5.stem: "The ocean surface ___ been restored to a flat plain after the wave."(现在完成被动语态,填那个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 浪过之后,海面已被重新恢复为平坦的一片。

stage5.stem: "To give energy or power to something is to ___ it."(“使充满能量,激励”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 给某物注入能量或动力。

stage5.stem: "The highest point of a wave is its ___."(“波峰”用哪个词)
"Causing great and sudden damage or suffering is ___."(“灾难性的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 造成巨大而突然的破坏或痛苦的。
